rules: Money is in Rs lakh except per-unit prices (Rs per unit).
industry must be one of 'industries'; it only changes labels, never calculations.
start_year = calendar year Year 1 starts in April (2026 = FY2026-27).

inputs.label: Industry / business type
inputs.note: Pick the business type — labels, units and notes across the whole model adapt. Calculations are identical for every industry.

inputs.label: Commercial operations start (FY)
inputs.note: Calendar year in which Year 1 starts (April). 2026 = FY2026-27. Every year / month heading in the model follows this.

inputs.label: Installed / service capacity
inputs.note: Rated output at 100% utilisation; effective output is governed by the utilisation ramp (Section 3). Define one 'unit' clearly for your business.

inputs.label: Working days / month (for WC norms)
inputs.note: Standard month convention for holding-period working-capital sizing.

inputs.label: Average selling price / unit (Yr1)
inputs.note: Net-of-GST realisation per unit; escalated year-on-year by the price escalation (Section 4).

inputs.label: Direct cost of goods / services per unit (Yr1)
inputs.note: Bought-in goods / direct cost of delivering one unit, inclusive of normal wastage.

inputs.label: Year 1 utilisation — month 1
inputs.note: Commissioning / launch ramp-up

inputs.label: Year 2 utilisation
inputs.note: Market established, ramp towards full capacity.

inputs.label: Year 3 utilisation
inputs.note: Efficient operating band.

inputs.label: Year 4 utilisation
inputs.note: Mature operations.

inputs.label: Year 5 utilisation
inputs.note: Sustainable ceiling (allows maintenance downtime).

inputs.label: Selling-price escalation
inputs.note: Realisation growth broadly tracking input inflation.

inputs.label: Direct-material escalation
inputs.note: Expected annual input-material price trend.

inputs.label: Utility / power tariff escalation
inputs.note: Annual drift in utility tariffs.

inputs.label: Wage / salary escalation
inputs.note: Annual increments + statutory revisions.

inputs.label: Other overhead escalation
inputs.note: General inflation on fixed overheads.

inputs.label: Utilities & energy / unit
inputs.note: Energy / utilities cost per unit; escalates with the utility-cost escalation (Section 4).

inputs.label: Consumables & supplies / unit
inputs.note: Consumable supplies consumed per unit.

inputs.label: Packing & delivery / unit
inputs.note: Packing / delivery / distribution cost per unit.

inputs.label: Direct labour (Year-1)
inputs.note: Operating staff across shifts; semi-fixed, escalates with wages.

inputs.label: Admin & management salaries
inputs.note: Management, sales, accounts, admin, security.

inputs.label: Fixed utility / facility charges
inputs.note: Fixed utility / contract-demand charges independent of volume.

inputs.label: Repairs & maintenance
inputs.note: Typically 1–2% of equipment cost per annum (spares, servicing).

inputs.label: Insurance
inputs.note: Typically ~0.4% of gross fixed assets p.a. (fire, burglary, breakdown).

inputs.label: Other admin overheads
inputs.note: Office, travel, communication, audit, statutory, misc.

inputs.label: Selling & distribution
inputs.note: Freight, commission, marketing & distribution (variable with sales).

inputs.label: Term loan sanctioned
inputs.note: Funds ~57% of fixed assets. See 'Project Cost' sheet.

inputs.label: Promoter equity / capital
inputs.note: Balancing contribution incl. WC margin money; D:E ≈ 1.04.

inputs.label: Term-loan interest rate
inputs.note: MSME term loan ≈ Repo (5.25%) + ~2.65% + spread. SBI/BoB EBLR basis, 2026.

inputs.label: Term-loan moratorium (principal)
inputs.note: Principal holiday during ramp-up; interest serviced monthly.

inputs.label: Term-loan repayment period
inputs.note: Equal monthly principal after moratorium (8-yr door-to-door).

inputs.label: Working-capital (CC) interest rate
inputs.note: Cash-credit on assessed bank finance. MSME WC 2026.

inputs.label: Raw-material / stock inventory  (days of consumption held)
inputs.note: Days of direct-cost consumption held in stock.

inputs.label: Finished goods / stock-in-trade  (days of cost held)
inputs.note: Days of cost of operations held as finished stock.

inputs.label: Receivables (debtors)
inputs.note: Credit allowed to customers.

inputs.label: Payables (creditors)
inputs.note: Credit received from suppliers.

inputs.label: Margin on working capital (NWC)
inputs.note: Tandon 2nd method: 25% of current assets from long-term funds.

inputs.label: Premises, building & civil / fit-out depreciation (SLM)
inputs.note: Building / civil — Companies Act Sch II (typical life ~30 yrs; confirm per asset).

inputs.label: Equipment, machinery & systems depreciation (SLM)
inputs.note: Equipment / machinery — Companies Act Sch II (typical life ~15 yrs; set per asset type).

inputs.label: Electrical installation depreciation (SLM)
inputs.note: Electrical installation — Companies Act Sch II (~10 yrs).

inputs.label: Utilities depreciation (SLM)
inputs.note: Utilities & services — Companies Act Sch II (~15 yrs).

inputs.label: Misc / office assets depreciation (SLM)
inputs.note: Office / furniture / IT — Companies Act Sch II (furniture 10 yrs, computers 3 yrs).

inputs.label: Pre-operative amortisation
inputs.note: Written off over 5 years (straight line).

inputs.label: Corporate tax rate (effective)
inputs.note: Sec 115BAA new domestic company: 22% + surcharge + cess ≈ 25.17%.

inputs.label: GST (pass-through)
inputs.note: Illustrative 18% output & input GST; revenue modelled net of GST. Set to the product’s actual GST rate.

inputs.label: Land & site development
inputs.note: Land / site / premises development (enter nil if premises are leased).

inputs.label: Premises, building & civil / fit-out
inputs.note: Construction / civil works / interiors & fit-out of premises.

inputs.label: Equipment, machinery & systems
inputs.note: Core equipment, machinery, vehicles or systems & installation.

inputs.label: Electrical installation & power back-up
inputs.note: Panels, wiring, transformer, DG / UPS back-up.

inputs.label: Utilities & services (water, HVAC, fire-fighting etc.)
inputs.note: Water, cooling / air-conditioning, fire-fighting, other services.

inputs.label: Miscellaneous fixed assets (office, IT, furniture, tools)
inputs.note: Furniture, computers, software / ERP, tools, testing equipment.

inputs.label: Contingency
inputs.note: ~3% on equipment / civil for cost overrun.

inputs.label: Pre-operative & preliminary expenses
inputs.note: Trial runs, interest during construction, fees, start-up and licensing costs.

inputs.label: Margin money for working capital
inputs.note: Promoter margin toward the first working-capital cycle.
